metadata.description: Focused Oct-12 B1 sensitivity simulation; EPG full sweep and reduced-grid event-level Bloch points.
metadata.kappa_definition: B1+ scale relative to nominal sequence calibration; uniform scale applied to all RF events.
metadata.interpretation_limit: The simulated transmit scale is a sensitivity parameter, not a measured spatial field. B0, receive sensitivity, motion, slice/profile and tissue differences are not causally separated by this calculation.

ideal_twist.note: The factor 0.5 applies to the prepared branch; full image ratio also includes re-excitation, variable refocusing, timings, and comparison with v1.83.

epg180.normalized_LR_assumption: (ss-MGOT L/R)/(v1.83 L/R), using interim midpoint 1.625/0.82; same receive-profile factor assumed to cancel.

epg166.normalized_LR_assumption: (ss-MGOT L/R)/(v1.83 L/R), using interim midpoint 1.625/0.82; same receive-profile factor assumed to cancel.

event_bloch_notes: 250 z points over 5 mm and 32 phase-axis points (v1.912). Point grid chosen for focused sensitivity; do not treat as a converged spatial map.
